note: T-276: border factors for the joint commute gravity (sim/src/bin/joint_gravity.rs) between zones of two packs. A pair of regions held by one pack takes that pack's own factor (its gravity block's border_factor); other pairs within a country (the line between two packs) take admin1_default, else pack_line_default (0.5 since T-1163, Anita 2026-10-24; 0.4 before, Japan's fit, the default for a country with no fit of its own, Anita 2026-10-16, T-584; before that no factor, T-181); pairs across a national border take national["A|B"] (alphabetical ISO 3166 codes) or national_default. US 0.23: the US packs' fit on LODES (T-162, T-198), unchanged by T-1163. JP 0.5 (T-1163, with pack_line_default): fitted at 0.4 between Japanese packs so the commuters between packs matched the 2020 census's between the same prefectures less telework (T-463; at 1 the model sent 1.9 times the census); prefecture lines inside a pack take no factor (T-420). seamless: pairs of packs whose line runs through one continuous city take their own factor, from the line's ordinary one up to 1 (T-1192, Anita 2026-10-24; written by pipeline/seams.py, rerun after a replan or a change of the defaults; km: line through city, side: the shared city's people on the smaller side). Everyday outings across a line inside a country take no factor (T-1175, bin/cross_everyday.rs); across a national border the national one. US-Canada 0.05: judgement, few thousand commute between Windsor and Detroit where a plain gravity would send several times more; fit it on census flows when a zone pair across the border is built.
